matched.actualTitle: HTTP Request Smuggling (CL.TE) - Authentication Bypass and HTTP Request Smuggling (CL.TE) - Proxy Access Control Bypass
matched.matchReason: The actual findings comprehensively document the expected CL.TE request smuggling vulnerability. Multiple actual findings confirm the core vulnerability: proxy uses Content-Length while backend uses Transfer-Encoding: chunked, allowing attackers to smuggle requests past proxy authentication. The actual findings demonstrate successful exploitation by accessing /admin/flag endpoint and extracting the flag 'FLAG{http_r3qu3st_smuggl1ng_cl_t3_succ3ss}', listing admin users, and bypassing the 403 Forbidden proxy protection. The attack technique, impact, and affected components all match the expected finding description.
